entries.en: The assistant albumenized the paper while the instructor explained the method.
entries.zh: 老师讲解方法时，助手给纸张涂了蛋白。

entries.en: We watched the instructor albumenizing paper for the demonstration.
entries.zh: 我们看着老师给纸张涂蛋白，以作演示。

entries.en: The review discussed plans to allotransplant skin between genetically different animals of the same species.
entries.zh: 综述讨论了在遗传上不同的同种动物之间移植皮肤的计划。

entries.en: The chemist asked whether the new catalyst could amidate the carboxylic acid.
entries.zh: 化学家提出疑问：新催化剂能否使该羧酸转化成酰胺？

entries.en: The report questioned whether the researchers had fully amidated the carboxylic acid.
entries.zh: 报告质疑，研究人员是否已把该羧酸完全转化成酰胺。

entries.en: We watched the lecturer anteflect the uterus on the anatomical model.
entries.zh: 我们看着讲师把解剖模型上的子宫向前弯曲。

entries.en: The arrow on the diagram of the torso pointed anteriad.
entries.zh: 躯干示意图上的箭头指向身体前方。

entries.en: The lecturer could antevert the model's uterus to illustrate the change in position.
entries.zh: 讲师可以使模型中的子宫前倾，来展示位置的变化。

entries.en: The diagram contrasted antiport across a membrane with transport moving both solutes in the same direction.
entries.zh: 该图把跨膜反向转运与两种溶质同向移动的转运方式作了对比。

entries.en: The gardener stored the bone meal beside the spare pots.
entries.zh: 园丁把骨粉存放在备用花盆旁。

entries.meaningZh: 进行盖髓处理〔现在分词〕
entries.en: The case report explained why the dentist was capping the exposed pulp.
entries.zh: 病例报告解释了牙医当时给暴露牙髓作盖髓处理的原因。

entries.en: The researchers stopped the trial when the wooden sample began charring.
entries.zh: 木质样品开始炭化时，研究人员停止了试验。

entries.en: The conservator was dipping the brush in water when the visitor arrived.
entries.zh: 修复师正将刷子浸入水中，这时访客到了。

entries.en: The seminar discussed the limits of lip reading in a noisy room.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了在嘈杂房间里唇读的局限。

entries.en: We visited the coastal village off season and found most shops closed.
entries.zh: 我们在淡季去了那个沿海村庄，发现多数商店关着。

entries.en: We watched the rainwater pour into the open tank.
entries.zh: 我们看着雨水注入敞开的水箱。

entries.en: The workers used a hand pump to pump up water from the flooded cellar.
entries.zh: 工人们用手动泵从积水的地窖里向上泵水。

entries.meaningZh: 发情；求偶〔动物，现在分词〕
entries.en: The wildlife camera recorded deer rutting beside the clearing.
entries.zh: 野生动物相机拍下了鹿在林间空地旁发情求偶的画面。

entries.en: They were setting up the measuring frame when the demonstration was postponed.
entries.zh: 演示被推迟时，他们正在装配测量框架。

entries.en: The paper compared nidal structures built by two species of wasp.
entries.zh: 论文比较了两种黄蜂筑成的巢结构。

entries.en: The image showed stromal tissue between the darker clusters of cells.
entries.zh: 图中较深色的细胞团之间可见基质组织。

entries.en: The review compared two methods for detecting retroviral sequences.
entries.zh: 综述比较了两种检测逆转录病毒序列的方法。

entries.en: The report discussed polychlorinated compounds found in the sediment samples.
entries.zh: 报告讨论了在沉积物样品中发现的多氯化化合物。

entries.en: The study used neurobehavioral assessments to examine changes in attention and movement.
entries.zh: 该研究通过神经行为评估考察注意力与动作的变化。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed the fascial layer beneath the highlighted muscle.
entries.zh: 解剖图显示了被突出标示的肌肉下方的筋膜层。

entries.en: The paper compared two pharmacokinetic models using the same set of measurements.
entries.zh: 论文使用同一组测量数据，比较了两种药物代谢动力学模型。

entries.en: The textbook compares Linnean classification with a system based on genetic evidence.
entries.zh: 教材比较了林奈分类法与一种以遗传证据为基础的分类系统。

entries.en: Her heteronomous decisions reflected her employer's wishes rather than her own convictions.
entries.zh: 她那些受人支配的决定体现的是雇主的意愿，而非自己的信念。

entries.meaningZh: 普通显微镜下不可见的
entries.en: The review distinguished submicroscopic structures from those visible with an ordinary microscope.
entries.zh: 综述把亚显微结构与普通显微镜下可见的结构区分开来。

entries.en: The illustrator gave the flask a piriform outline, wider below than above.
entries.zh: 插画师把烧瓶轮廓画成梨形，下部比上部宽。

entries.en: The review questioned whether the reported sign was truly pathognomonic.
entries.zh: 综述质疑，是否确实能凭所报告的体征确定诊断。

entries.en: The telekinetic heroine in the novel moved a cup without touching it.
entries.zh: 小说里具有隔空移物能力的女主角没碰杯子，就让它移动了。

entries.en: The technician measured the anteroposterior diameter on the anatomical image.
entries.zh: 技术人员在解剖图像上测量了前后径。

entries.en: The anatomy lecture used a diagram of the ejaculatory ducts.
entries.zh: 解剖课使用了一幅射精管示意图。

entries.en: The review grouped transfemoral procedures separately from those using other access routes.
entries.zh: 综述把经股入路的操作与使用其他入路的操作分开归类。

entries.en: The image showed a myxoid area beside denser tissue.
entries.zh: 图像中可见一片黏液样区域，旁边是更致密的组织。

entries.en: The pathology report discussed hypostatic congestion but did not identify its cause.
entries.zh: 病理报告讨论了坠积性充血，但没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The diagram marked the supraclavicular region but did not show the deeper structures.
entries.zh: 该图标出了锁骨上区，但未显示更深层的结构。

entries.en: The clinical review separated semiological observations from laboratory test results.
entries.zh: 临床综述把症状学观察与实验室检测结果作了区分。

entries.en: The study compared the lytic activity of two enzymes on bacterial cells.
entries.zh: 该研究比较了两种酶对细菌细胞的溶菌活性。

entries.en: The paper discussed respirable particles without claiming that they were safe to inhale.
entries.zh: 论文讨论了能够被吸入的颗粒，但并未声称吸入它们是安全的。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed the infratemporal region from the side.
entries.zh: 解剖图从侧面展示了颞下区域。

entries.en: The artist used a versicolor fabric to brighten the otherwise plain room.
entries.zh: 艺术家用一块多色布料为那间装饰素净的房间增添亮色。

entries.en: The report compared the flexural strength of two panel designs.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两种板材设计的抗弯强度。

entries.en: The review distinguished hypomanic episodes from ordinary short-lived excitement.
entries.zh: 综述把轻躁狂发作与普通、短暂的兴奋区分开来。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram showed the arytenoid cartilage from two angles.
entries.zh: 解剖图从两个角度展示了杓状软骨。
